run_interactive_repeat_query: run the Interactive module with the repeat_query model in interactive mode
run_safe_interactive: run the SafeInteractive module with the repeat_query model in safe interactive mode
run_interactive_with_task: run the Interactive module with a specific task like convai2 and datatype
run_interactive_with_logging: run the Interactive module with conversation logging to a JSONL outfile
run_interactive_web_server: run the InteractiveWeb server on a random port and test the interact endpoint
